scope.statement: Project-owned representative questions for three materially different trusted-local RDF applications: staffing, service operations, and research cataloging.
scope.denominator_rule: All question records frozen with scope=in_scope.
scope.exclusion_rule: Exclusions and their reasons are frozen before classification; post-freeze exclusions require a new corpus revision.

scenarios.name: Delivery staffing and skills registry
scenarios.description: Staffing coordinators maintain employee assignments and declared expertise to assemble project teams and audit coverage.
scenarios.material_difference: Workforce allocation and skill discovery over people, projects, and expertise.

scenarios.name: Service ownership and incident operations
scenarios.description: Incident commanders and platform operators use a service catalog to find accountable teams, runbooks, deployments, and dependencies.
scenarios.material_difference: Operational ownership and incident response over services, teams, deployments, and runbooks.

scenarios.name: Institutional research and publication catalog
scenarios.description: Research-information staff maintain publications, contributors, grants, venues, datasets, departments, and deposit states.
scenarios.material_difference: Bibliographic reporting and stewardship over scholarly outputs and research administration.

threshold_notes: Approved project-owned starting thresholds for the representative benchmark before classification. This experiment demonstrates internal product evidence and does not substitute for validation with external application owners.
notes: All source material is trusted local representative input. No protected-data, production-authorization, or external-application validity claim is made.
